name: Truchet Canvas
description: Full-viewport p5 canvas of colored Truchet tiles with a grain texture. Hovering flips tiles under the cursor and clicking regenerates the whole pattern.
contents: Full-size canvas grid of diagonal Truchet tiles with noise grain
behavior: Hovering a cell flips its tile and recolors the grid
Click or tap regenerates a random grid
Canvas resizes with the window and rebuilds the grid
editableByProps: Tile hue, cell size, outline thickness and color, grain strength

needsCodeEdit.change: Change what hover and click do
needsCodeEdit.where: p.mouseMoved and p.mousePressed in the sketch

fixed: Canvas is sized to the window and the root is h-screen full width, override height with className
Saturation alternates between full and zero, only hue is configurable
